remarks: Renovated and freshly painted 2BR/2 full bath condo w/fireplace, private patio, garage, and brand new windows and slider in the charming Wolfpit neighborhood. Enjoy single level living w/a completely updated, open concept kitchen featuring new cabinets, appliances, quartz countertops. A large coat closet/pantry off the kitchen offers great storage. The spacious, open living/dining area features a cozy fireplace and access through the sliders to your private patio and peaceful backyard. Primary bedroom w/double closets, ceiling fan and en-suite bath. Additional generously sized bedroom w/large closet and easy access to the hall bath. Side-by-side laundry is conveniently tucked away in a hall closet with extra storage. Newly updated HVAC system ensuring comfortable heat and central air year round. Private one car garage plus off street parking for additional cars and guests. Available immediately. Pets welcome. Don't miss this stylish, move in ready rental in a location close to everything!
